subject: Re: Pricing follow-up / token benchmarking - Acme
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up / token benchmarking - Acme

Hi Sam & Priya 

Thanks again for the call today  great to learn more about Acme's plans for integrating real-time summarization and chat into the support UX. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

- Volumes: you mentioned steady-state ~150M tokens/month with spikes to ~400M for launch; average context length ~1.2k tokens per session.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime target, p95 latency goal ~400ms for most requests.
- Data: model outputs can include customer PII; you'll want Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS.
- Key decision criteria: unit economics ($/1M tokens), latency, and fallback reliability.

We ran a quick benchmarking pass against common hosts and open-model endpoints to give you an initial sense of target pricing and how Redwood compares. Attached: redwood_vs_hosts_token_pricing.xlsx and a short traffic estimate CSV from your numbers.

A couple asks for you so we can finalize a pilot quote: 
1) Confirm the 150M steady-state and whether the 400M peak is an expected sustained level during the 3-month launch window.
2) Confirm if you require Private (VPC) deployment from day one or if Dedicated Reserved capacity is acceptable for the pilot.
3) Any internal target for maximum monthly spend for the pilot (ballpark budget helps us structure the PoC).

Preliminary pricing note (high-level): based on the workloads you shared, we're looking at a target competitive pilot price in the $10-14 per 1M tokens band for optimized open-model variants. For context, common public list rates we see: OpenAI ~ $20/1M on comparable footprints, Anthropic ~ $18/1M, and some open-model hosts range $10-15/1M depending on quantization and batch profiles. See full breakdown in the attached sheet.

Next steps: if you confirm the numbers above, Marissa and I will put together a 3-month pilot proposal with a target $/1M price and a burst-cap plan for launch.

Thanks 
Vanessa
VP, Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vs_hosts_token_pricing.xlsx, acme_mvp_traffic_estimates.csv

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up / token benchmarking - Acme

Vanessa - thanks for the recap and the speedy turnaround. Couple quick clarifications: 

- Confirm steady-state = 150M tokens/month. The 400M is a launch peak we expect for ~2 weeks.
- We'd prefer Dedicated reserved capacity for the pilot if that keeps latency predictable, but we need to see pricing that meets our finance constraints.
- Target budget: we were hoping to keep the core inference spend under $5k/month for the pilot (we can absorb infra ops costs separately).

Given 150M steady state, can you show what 150M and 400M look like at different $/1M tiers (e.g., $10/$12/$15/$20) and include any setup/commit requirements for Dedicated? Also, we're tracking the competitive baseline - our procurement team has OpenAI and Anthropic baseline quotes that are roughly in the $18-22 per 1M range for the models they proposed.

Thanks 
Sam
Senior PM, Acme Corp

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up / token benchmarking - Acme

Sam - great, thanks for confirming. I've pulled the simple unit-economics table into the attached workbook (redwood_vs_hosts_token_pricing.xlsx) but here's the quick view inline so you can see the tier math immediately: 

Scenario math (rounded):
- 150M tokens/month:
  - $10 / 1M -> $1,500 / month
  - $12 / 1M -> $1,800 / month
  - $15 / 1M -> $2,250 / month
  - $20 / 1M -> $3,000 / month

- 400M tokens/month (peak sustained for 2 weeks, pro-rated):
  - $10 -> $4,000 (peak month)
  - $12 -> $4,800
  - $15 -> $6,000
  - $20 -> $8,000

Competitive context (benchmarks we see from procurement conversations and public pricing):
- OpenAI: ~ $18-22 / 1M for the models used in your flow (higher for gpt-4 variants); pricing for longer contexts and streaming can drive this up.
- Anthropic: ~ $16-20 / 1M on the comparable models.
- Open-model hosts / self-serve infra: ~ $10-15 / 1M depending on quantization (4-bit) and autoscaling economics.

Where Redwood can help: for Dedicated pilots we can structure a short-term reserved commit that targets $12 / 1M for the pilot (3 months) with a launch-burst allowance that triggers a higher overage price if you exceed the reserved burst threshold. The pilot commit would be a modest monthly minimum to secure the reserved capacity - I'll have finance draft the proposal once you sign off on the numbers.

Notes / assumptions in the workbook: batching and KV caching on session prefixes assumed, 4-bit quantization for token-cost estimates on open models, and no additional feature charges (observability retention is optional).

Next asks: if $12 / 1M and a small monthly commit to reserve Dedicated looks acceptable, we'll circulate a formal pilot SOW and the Reserved Capacity pricing sheet.

Thanks 
Vanessa

Attachments: redwood_vs_hosts_token_pricing.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing follow-up / token benchmarking - Acme

Marissa / Rishi - forwarding the thread. Acme is asking for a pilot that keeps inference spend <= $5k/month if possible. Their steady state is 150M tokens/mo; they expect 400M peak during launch (2 weeks). They have OpenAI/Anthropic baseline quotes in the $18-22 / 1M band.

Proposal idea: offer a 3-month Dedicated reserved pilot at $12 / 1M with a $1,500/month minimum (covers the steady-state at $10-12 area) and a launch-burst allowance (covering up to 400M in a month at an overage rate of $18 / 1M). This keeps their monthly invoice predictable and gives them a material saving vs OpenAI/Anthropic quotes. Can we get pricing approval to proceed?

I attached the benchmarking sheet we sent Acme. If you want, Rishi, loop in infra to confirm the burst capacity plan and latency SLO mapping.

Thanks 
Vanessa
VP, Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vs_hosts_token_pricing.xlsx
